# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It summarises the project rules (content only in `assets-web-design/data-N.json`, `WL.esc()` on every value, CSS variables only, BEM classes with `data-*` hooks, `render`/`mount`/`unmount` lifecycle, never edit `wd2026.js`).

For component work, read `skills/skills/wl-builder/SKILL.md` and the matching file in `skills/skills/wl-builder/references/` (start with `component-catalog.md` and `layout-params.md`).
